name: WP TripAdvisor Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Display TripAdvisor Reviews on Your WordPress Site in Under 2 Minutes — Fast, Local & Built for Hospitality, Travel, and Restaurants.

WP TripAdvisor Review Slider downloads your TripAdvisor (Trip Advisor) hotel, restaurant, vacation rental, attraction, tour, and activity reviews and stores them directly in your WordPress database (utf8mb4 emoji-ready) on your own server. Because reviews are served locally instead of calling TripAdvisor on every page view, your website stays fast, cache-friendly, and optimized for Core Web Vitals.

Travelers and diners check TripAdvisor before they book or reserve a table. Showcasing verified TripAdvisor guest reviews, user-uploaded review photos, and a TripAdvisor rating summary badge (with official-style rating bubbles and total review counts) next to your booking engine, menu, or tour checkout builds immediate social proof and boosts direct conversions.

Here’s a quick video demonstration of adding TripAdvisor reviews in less than 2 minutes!

Why Choose WP TripAdvisor Review Slider?

  • Works With Hotels, Restaurants, Attractions, Tours & Vacation Rentals: Paste any TripAdvisor business listing URL and import your latest guest reviews, titles, avatars, and photos.
  • Multi-Source / Multi-Location Support: Add multiple TripAdvisor business URLs on the Get TripAdvisor Reviews page, download reviews for each property or tour, and assign each template to display its matching TripAdvisor source.
  • TripAdvisor Summary Rating Badge: Place a customizable TripAdvisor summary badge on the left, right, or above your reviews — or display the badge standalone — showing the saved source average rating, rating bubbles, and total review count.
  • Guest Review Photos & Lightbox: Download traveler-uploaded photos attached to TripAdvisor reviews and display them with a click-to-enlarge image lightbox.
  • Built-In Review Analytics Dashboard: Visualize your average rating, 1-to-5 rating distribution, review volume timeline, rating trends over time, and positive/negative keyword word clouds inside wp-admin.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive Review Slider, Carousel, Grid & List: Display TripAdvisor reviews in an animated horizontal slider or a multi-row, multi-column responsive grid.
  • Two Modern Template Styles + Live Preview: Choose between Style 1 (classic speech bubble) and Style 6 (modern review card layout) in a tabbed template editor (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with live AJAX preview and save.
  • TripAdvisor Rating Summary Badge: Customize badge placement, business photo/logo, colors, border, drop shadow, and “Based on…” / “Review us on…” text.
  • Review List & Popup Editing: Manage all downloaded TripAdvisor reviews in one place. Easily hide/show individual reviews, edit reviewer avatars and dates in an AJAX popup without losing your place, or delete reviews.
  • Smart Template Filtering: Filter reviews by minimum rating (e.g., only 4- and 5-bubble reviews), hide reviews without text, sort by newest or random order, and select which TripAdvisor location a template displays.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize rating colors, verified review badges, reviewer last name format (full name, hidden, or initial), avatar style (traveler photo, mystery icon, initials, or hidden), TripAdvisor icon link, font sizes, background/text colors, border radius, and custom CSS.
  • Advanced Slider & Layout Controls: Configure autoplay, slide speed and delay, show/hide navigation arrows and dots, mobile swipe support, one-review-per-slide mobile mode, equal-height review cards (Reviews Same Height), and expandable Read More links.
  • Display Anywhere: Embed unlimited review templates on any page, post, sidebar, or footer using the WP TripAdvisor Review Slider block, a shortcode, a WordPress widget, or a PHP template function.
  • WordPress Dashboard Widget: View your latest TripAdvisor reviews right on your WordPress admin dashboard.

Check Out Our Other Free Review Slider Plugins

  • Google Reviews
  • Facebook & X (Twitter) Reviews
  • Yelp Reviews
  • Airbnb Reviews
  • Thumbtack Reviews
  • Zillow Reviews
  • WooCommerce Product Reviews

Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro for More Features

Want to download up to 100+ TripAdvisor reviews automatically every day and combine them with Google, Booking.com, Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, OpenTable, and Yelp reviews? Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro:

  • Download More TripAdvisor Reviews & Daily Auto-Sync: Download up to 100+ TripAdvisor reviews with media per source (or even more via Review Funnels) and set a daily cron job to automatically import new reviews.
  • 150+ Review Sites for Travel, Hospitality & Dining: Import and combine reviews from TripAdvisor, Google, Booking.com, Airbnb, VRBO, Expedia, Hotels.com, Kayak, Priceline, Orbitz, Travelocity, Agoda, MakeMyTrip, Rakuten Travel, Hostelworld, GetYourGuide, InnStyle, OpenTable, TheFork, DesignMyNight, Yelp, Facebook, DoorDash, Uber Eats, Grubhub, Zomato, OpenRice, and 120+ more platforms!
  • Combine Multiple Locations & Platforms in One Template: Mix TripAdvisor, Google, Booking.com, and Facebook reviews into a single all-in-one slider or grid, or filter dynamically by Post ID, Category, language, or custom tags.
  • Custom Review Sources & AI Import: Add any custom travel or booking platform with your own logo, and use AI to extract and import reviews automatically.
  • AI Review Summaries & Deep AI Analysis: Display an AI-generated “Guests Say” or “Travelers Say” summary in your template header or badge, run full AI Sentiment & SWOT Analysis reports (themes, pain points, traveler personas, and action items), and draft AI Management Responses.
  • 15 Review Template Styles & Masonry Grids: Unlock 15 pre-built template styles (including media-focused card layouts), Masonry grids, continuous-scroll carousels, custom responsive breakpoints, and child-theme template overrides.
  • Interactive Front-End Header, Search & Pagination: Add a front-end search bar, sort dropdown, rating/source filter, tag filter pills, Load More button, Endless Scroll, or numbered pagination.
  • 7 Summary Badge Styles, Floating Badges & Slide-Out Drawers: Choose from 7 standalone badge designs, pin floating badges or review pop-ins to the corner of your site, and open a slide-out or pop-up review drawer on click.
  • Front-End Guest Review Forms & Smart Review Gate: Collect direct guest feedback on your site with custom fields, photo/video uploads, and reCAPTCHA. Route happy guests to TripAdvisor or Google while capturing low ratings privately.
  • Automated Review Request Emails (Autoresponders): Send automatic post-stay or post-booking review request emails with open/click tracking.
  • Shareable Social Media Review Cards & Email Signatures: Turn 5-star traveler reviews into high-resolution PNG social graphics (with Google Fonts & Unsplash backgrounds) and build live-rating email signatures.
  • Google Rich Snippet Schema (JSON-LD), Auto-Translate, Webhooks & White-Label: Output valid JSON-LD AggregateRating schema markup, auto-translate multi-language traveler reviews via Google Translate API (with WPML support), send new reviews to Zapier, Make, or n8n via webhooks, sync with TrustGuide, import/export CSVs, and enable Agency White-Label Mode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-tripadvisor-review-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install WP TripAdvisor Review Slider from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP TripAdvisor in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Go to Get TripAdvisor Reviews, paste your TripAdvisor business URL(s), and click Download Reviews.
  5. Check Review List and Analytics to inspect your imported reviews, traveler photos, and rating charts.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page, then insert the WP TripAdvisor Review Slider block or add the shortcode to any page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Are TripAdvisor reviews stored on my server?

Yes. After you download reviews from TripAdvisor, they are saved in your WordPress database on your own server. Your site displays those stored reviews locally instead of calling TripAdvisor on every page view, keeping your pages fast and cache-friendly.

Can I download reviews from multiple TripAdvisor locations or listings?

Yes. On the Get TripAdvisor Reviews page you can add multiple TripAdvisor business URLs (hotels, restaurants, attractions, tours, or vacation rentals) and download reviews for each source. In the free version, each review template can display one chosen TripAdvisor source. In WP Review Slider Pro, you can also combine multiple locations and 150+ review platforms into a single template.

How do I find my TripAdvisor URL?

Go to TripAdvisor, open your hotel, restaurant, attraction, or tour page, and copy the URL from your browser’s address bar. Paste that URL into the Get TripAdvisor Reviews page.

Does this plugin update TripAdvisor reviews automatically?

In the free version, you click Download Reviews manually whenever you want to import new reviews. WP Review Slider Pro includes a daily cron job that automatically checks for new TripAdvisor reviews every day.

Can I display TripAdvisor review photos?

Yes. Traveler-uploaded photos attached to TripAdvisor reviews are downloaded and displayed in your slider or grid, and open in a responsive lightbox popup when clicked.

Can I add a TripAdvisor review summary badge?

Yes. Each template includes a Badge tab so you can place a TripAdvisor summary badge (with your saved source average rating, rating bubbles, and total review count) on the left, top, or right of your reviews — or display the badge standalone.

Can I hide or edit individual reviews?

Yes. On the Review List page you can hide, edit (in an AJAX popup), or delete individual reviews at any time.

Can I filter out low-star reviews?

Yes. In your template Filter settings, you can set a minimum rating so only high-rated reviews are displayed.

How do I request a new feature?

We are always looking for features to add! Post on the support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.

15.4

  • Added a Setup Wizard, opened from the Welcome page, that downloads your TripAdvisor reviews, helps you pick a look, and adds them to a page.
  • Added a Header Options tab on the Templates page that previews the Pro header, search, sort, and filter options.
  • Added a rating request to the admin footer on the plugin’s pages.
  • The Card style (Style 6) now uses fixed review text and date sizes, so it looks the same with any theme.
  • Fixed the Card style (Style 6) grid stacking into one column on some themes when the rating badge is beside the reviews.
  • Fixed the verified check mark sitting lower than the stars in the Card style (Style 6) with some themes.
  • The TripAdvisor logo on reviews is now 26px tall in both Style 1 and the Card style (Style 6).
  • The logo in the Above Wide badge now lines up with the right edge of the button below it.

15.3

  • Added a WP TripAdvisor Review Slider block so a saved template can be inserted in the block editor.
  • The block shows the selected template in the editor.
  • Edit Template in the block toolbar opens that template in a new tab.
  • Refresh in the block toolbar reloads the template preview.
  • Open Templates opens in a new tab and reminds you to refresh the editor after creating a template.

15.2

  • Template style dropdown previews udpated.
  • Sample AI Analysis page updated.
  • Updated Freemius SDK.

15.1

  • Checks the reviews table encoding on update and converts legacy utf8 (3-byte) tables to utf8mb4 so reviews containing emojis can be saved.

15.0

  • Badge shows the TripAdvisor source average, star bubbles, and total review count stored for each location.

14.9

  • Added a new Analytics page for review insights and charts.
  • Added Pro feature highlights and upgrade nudges throughout the admin.
  • Template Filter limited to one source location in free (multi-source is Pro).

14.8

  • small bug fix with png naming

14.7

  • Security fix: crawler requests now verify TLS certificates (previously disabled), preventing a network man-in-the-middle from injecting forged review data.
  • Security fix: review data from the crawler is sanitized on ingestion and storage, and escaped on output in the admin dashboard widget (stored XSS hardening).
  • Security fix: the template “Filter by Source” value is no longer concatenated into SQL; it is now a bound query parameter, and is restricted to a safe charset at save time (SQL injection fix).
  • Fixed a stray invisible character appearing at the top of Template Style 6 output.
  • Review List: editing a review now opens in a popup and saves via AJAX instead of reloading the page, so your place in a long review list is preserved.

14.6

  • Added multi-source TripAdvisor support: add multiple business URLs, download each source separately, and filter templates by source.
  • Badge average rating and total review counts are now stored per TripAdvisor source for more accurate badge display.
  • Review List improvements: hide, edit, and delete reviews, plus a Source Name column.
  • Safer review download deduplication to reduce duplicate imports.
  • Template polish for Style 6, side badges, verified icons, and admin help text toggles.
  • Existing single-source setups remain backward compatible and default to the available TripAdvisor source.

14.5

  • Added full Review Template settings parity with the Google free plugin: Style 6, badge settings, advanced slider controls, avatar/name/icon options, location filter, AJAX save/preview, and more. Existing templates remain backward compatible.
